features: Tuneify Complete UI Redesign: Organic Glassmorphism + Material Expressive + Dynamic Artwork specification
Home Screen: Distinctive Tuneify 5-bar waveform mark, expressive greeting, organic-shaped glass hero card with carousel indicators, category pills, Quick Picks and Made For You collections

Now Playing Screen: Organic asymmetric fluid artwork wave container with glowing radiant aura, interactive audio-reactive waveform progress scrubber, circular Volt Lime play/pause controls, and frosted glass shortcut pills (Lyrics, Queue, Equalizer)
Explore Screen: Expressive heading, glass search button, filter pills (For You, Moods, Genres, Decades), featured music banner, and vertical glass Trending Now song rows
Floating translucent glass bottom navigation bar with active Volt Lime capsule indicator across Home, Explore, Library, and Search
bug_fixes: Offset shadows (neoShadow) now follow the shape's corner radius instead of always drawing a square black box
Dark mode no longer paints a near-white outline around every card; borders are hairlines and only interactive elements get a strong outline
Prevent missing song-ID map crashes in Quick Picks and Forgotten Favorites by keeping randomized Room relation queries stable across statement resets
